name: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited

annual_report.business: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited is a company that previously operated as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) but had its Certificate of Registration cancelled by the RBI in 2002; it currently has no plant locations and its business activities are not explicitly described in the provided excerpts beyond managing legacy deposit liabilities under a High Court sanctioned scheme.

auditor.name: M/s. H G Sarvaiya & Co, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified Opinion: The Company has not provided for Delayed Period Interest Cost on Deposit amount to Rs.47.91 Lakhs for the year ending 31st March 2026 and Rs.11.95 Lakhs for the quarter ending 31st March 2026, cumulative Impact of Interest cost not provided from OCTOBER 2019 to MARCH 2026, is Rs.381.67 Lakhs. To that extent, profit is overstated and liability understated. Emphasis of Matter: (a) As per scheme sanctioned by Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka vide order dated 8th October 2004, all deposits/bonds were required to be repaid by 15th June 2009 / 15th September 2009. The total principal and accrued interest payable to the public, outstanding as on date, amounts to Rs. 1,370.06 lakhs. During FY 2023-24, the Company deposited Rs. 1,395.75 lakhs with the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka. (b) RBI cancelled the Certificate of Registration granted to the Company to act as NBFC by order dated 13th June 2002.

key_risks: Non-provision of delayed period interest cost on deposits leading to overstatement of profit and understatement of liability (Rs. 381.67 lakhs cumulative)
Outstanding deposit liabilities of Rs. 1,370.06 lakhs payable to public under High Court sanctioned scheme
RBI cancellation of NBFC Certificate of Registration in 2002
Ongoing legal proceedings and deposit repayment obligations
